mentions.name: Zürich Ratsinfo
mentions.description: A tool for Zürich's city council that transforms buried legislative data into accessible formats, scrapes daily, parses votes, and auto-generates social media posts of council votes.
mentions.problem: Zürich city council legislative data is buried and unavailable in accessible formats.
mentions.source_excerpt: We're doing something similar for Zürich's city council at https://github.com/SiiiTschiii/zuerichratsinfo, transforming buried legislative data into accessible formats and auto-posting votes to social media.
